svg.text: A quadratic correction removes systematic real-domain bias.
The raw synthetic-trained ensemble overpredicted Nenrus distances; a small real calibration set learns the output-scale mapping.
RAW ENSEMBLE PREDICTION → CALIBRATED METRIC DISTANCE
r = raw ensemble prediction, z = corrected metric distance
The real error was systematic overprediction (99.8%), not random noise.
The quadratic mapping corrects scale bias without retraining the RF-XGBoost ensemble.
Curves: final functions fit on all 489 Nenrus rows. Performance claim: repeated split evaluation with 20% calibration data and the remaining rows held out.
